Package game.plants

Class PeriodicAbility

java.lang.Object
game.plants.PeriodicAbility
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlantAbility
Direct Known Subclasses:
Grow, Produce, SelfReplicate
public abstract class PeriodicAbility extends Object implements PlantAbility
Abstract base class for plant abilities that happen every N turns of the plant's age, possibly with a chance of failing.

"Every N turns" means the turns where the plant's age is a multiple of N: N, 2N, 3N and so on. tryPerform(game.plants.Plant, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location) is final, so every subclass shares the same timing rule and only writes its own effect in perform(game.plants.Plant, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location).

  • Constructor Details

    • PeriodicAbility

      protected PeriodicAbility(int intervalTurns, int chancePercent, RandomUtils randomUtils)
      Creates an ability that happens every given number of turns, with the given chance.
      Parameters:
      intervalTurns - how many turns of age between attempts; must be positive
      chancePercent - the chance, as a percentage, that it happens on its turn; must be from 0 to 100
      randomUtils - the randomness used to roll the chance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the interval is not positive or the chance is outside 0 to 100

    • PeriodicAbility

      protected PeriodicAbility(int intervalTurns, RandomUtils randomUtils)
      Creates an ability that always happens every given number of turns.
      Parameters:
      intervalTurns - how many turns of age between attempts; must be positive
      randomUtils - the randomness used to roll the chance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the interval is not positive

    • tryPerform

      public final String tryPerform(Plant plant, Location location)
      Performs the effect if the plant's age is a multiple of the interval and the chance roll succeeds. The turn is checked before rolling, so no random number is used on the other turns.
      Specified by:
      tryPerform in interface PlantAbility
      Parameters:
      plant - the plant using this ability
      location - the location of the plant
      Returns:
      a description of what happened, or an empty string if nothing happened

      public final String forcePerform(Plant plant, Location location)
      Performs this ability's effect immediately, skipping the interval and chance checks tryPerform(game.plants.Plant, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location) normally applies.
